entries.name: ledger-balanced-definer
entries.claim: The deferred balance check runs as its owner, so a write committed as the runtime role is not refused at COMMIT (review R5).
entries.original: ALTER FUNCTION north_star_internal.ledger_entry_balanced() SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
entries.replacement: ALTER FUNCTION north_star_internal.ledger_entry_balanced() SECURITY INVOKER SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;

kills.name: a writer call committed as the runtime role passes the deferred balance check
kills.expected: a runtime-originated entry was refused at commit: permission denied

entries.name: ledger-instant-offset
entries.claim: An instant without Z or a numeric offset is refused, never read in the session time zone (review R2).
entries.original: IF date_basis ? 'instant' AND (jsonb_typeof(date_basis->'instant') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
entries.replacement: IF false AND date_basis ? 'instant' AND (jsonb_typeof(date_basis->'instant') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'

kills.name: an instant without Z or a numeric offset is refused
kills.expected: Missing expected rejection: an instant without an offset was read in the session time zone

entries.name: ledger-date-pin-cast
entries.claim: The structural date pin catches CAST(x AS date) outside the resolver (review R3).

kills.name: accounting dates come only from the company business-day resolver
kills.expected: ledger SQL outside the resolver contains a CAST to date

entries.name: ledger-date-pin-call
entries.claim: The structural date pin catches date(x) outside the resolver (review R3).

kills.name: accounting dates come only from the company business-day resolver
kills.expected: ledger SQL outside the resolver contains a call of the date function
